name: Autonomous Organizations
tagline: Teams of agents that coordinate through Slack, Linear and other surfaces to reach a high-level goal - assigning, communicating, deciding and executing with minimal human intervention

charter.focus: teams of agents coordinating through work surfaces toward a high-level goal, within the PBC's human-governed model
charter.mission: Ensure advanced AI is governed as a public good, with benefits shared widely and deployed toward humanity's most urgent challenges.

zones.name: Goal Wall
zones.purpose: The high-level goal the team is accomplishing, written where every agent can read it

zones.name: Coordination Floor
zones.purpose: Coordinating through surfaces like Slack, Linear and other tools
zones.source: worlds/sources/founder-tracks-2026-09-28.md, Autonomous Organizations: 'coordinate through surfaces like Slack, Linear, and other tools'

zones.name: Decision Room
zones.purpose: Making decisions - drafted by agents, with the final vote reserved for human stewards

zones.name: Execution Bay
zones.purpose: Executing the assigned work with minimal human intervention, inside the reserved-actions line
zones.source: worlds/sources/founder-tracks-2026-09-28.md, Autonomous Organizations: 'executing with minimal human intervention'

agents.name: Goal Keeper
agents.role: Keeps the high-level goal current and measurable

agents.name: Coordinator Agent
agents.role: Coordinates the team through Slack, Linear and other surfaces

agents.name: Assigner
agents.role: Assigns work and tracks who holds what

agents.name: Communicator
agents.role: Communicates status and blockers across the team

agents.name: Decision Drafter
agents.role: Drafts decisions with evidence; never enacts one

agents.name: Executor
agents.role: Executes assigned work and reports back

gaps: No Slack or Linear workspace is connected and no goal is given; the surfaces are named, not wired
'Minimal human intervention' is bounded by the PBC reserved list: final votes and enactment stay with stewards
